description: This file defines the class MessageOnlyLogFilter, which implements the LogNode interface. It filters log messages to only pass along the message content, omitting metadata like tags or priorities, suitable for display purposes.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter for log messages that forwards only the message content, ignoring other metadata, to the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with an optional next LogNode for chaining.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters the log message to pass only the message to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
